server.name: io.github.ryaker/appstore-connect-mcp
server.description: MCP server for Apple Store Connect API integration with OAuth authentication support

environmentVariables.description: Apple App Store Connect API Key ID
environmentVariables.name: APPLE_KEY_ID

environmentVariables.description: Apple App Store Connect Issuer ID
environmentVariables.name: APPLE_ISSUER_ID

environmentVariables.description: Apple App Store Connect Private Key (base64 encoded or raw)
environmentVariables.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional: Specific Bundle ID to filter apps
environmentVariables.name: APPLE_BUNDLE_ID

environmentVariables.description: Optional: Specific App Store ID
environmentVariables.name: APPLE_APP_STORE_ID

environmentVariables.description: Enable OAuth authentication (true/false)
environmentVariables.name: OAUTH_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: OAuth issuer URL (e.g., https://your-tenant.auth0.com)
environmentVariables.name: OAUTH_ISSUER

environmentVariables.description: OAuth audience URL
environmentVariables.name: OAUTH_AUDIENCE

environmentVariables.description: OAuth JWKS URI for token validation
environmentVariables.name: OAUTH_JWKS_URI

environmentVariables.description: Server URL for OAuth deployment
environmentVariables.name: SERVER_URL
